description_en: Queries the IP addresses of DTS servers by calling the WhiteIpList operation
description_zh: 调用WhiteIpList接口查询DTS服务器的IP地址
kebab_example: aliyun dts white-ip-list --type vpc --biz-region cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: WhiteIpList

parameters.help_en:
The connection method of the self-managed database or third-party ApsaraDB database. Valid values:
internet: connected over the Internet.
vpc: connected over Express Connect, VPN Gateway, or Smart Access Gateway
parameters.help_zh:
自建数据库或第三方云数据库的接入方式，取值为
internet：通过公网接入。
vpc：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the source instance. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html.
If the source instance is a self-managed database with a public IP address or a third-party ApsaraDB database, you can set this parameter to ap-southeast-1 or the area ID that is geographically closest to the database
parameters.help_zh:
源实例所属地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html。
如果源实例为有公网IP的自建数据库或第三方云数据库，则可以传入cn-hangzhou或者离该类数据库物理距离最近的区域ID
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the destination instance. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html.

If the destination instance is a self-managed database with a public IP address or a third-party ApsaraDB database, you can set this parameter to ap-southeast-1 or the area ID that is geographically closest to the database.
This parameter is required when the DTS task is a data migration or data synchronization task
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例所属地域ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html。

如果目标实例为有公网IP的自建数据库或第三方云数据库，则可以传入cn-hangzhou或者离该类数据库物理距离最近的区域ID。
当DTS任务为迁移或同步时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: destination_region

parameters.help_en: The region to which the DTS instance belongs. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
true: The node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node.
false: The node is not a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node

true：是。
false：否
